activity.notes: Harold Godwinson (Harold II) was selected by the Witan after Edward the Confessor's death and crowned at Westminster Abbey on 6 January 1066. His reign ended with his death at the Battle of Hastings on 14 October 1066. ATLAS records the short, well-attested royal reign at day granularity.

sources.title: Harold II (r. Jan - Oct 1066) — The Royal Family
sources.citation_text: The Royal Family states that Harold was crowned at Westminster Abbey on 6 January 1066 and died at the Battle of Hastings on 14 October 1066.

sources.title: A Restless Reign: King Harold in 1066 — English Heritage
sources.citation_text: English Heritage confirms Harold's accession in January 1066 and death at Hastings on 14 October 1066.
